fusions.name: Bolt and Boot
fusions.desc: Bolts up to 7 tiles to the target and kicks it for 13 damage. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt. For 4s after using it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Burrow Scatter
fusions.desc: Looses 3 pellets at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage. 15% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Greens on the Run
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. You restore 10 health when you cast it. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Fed Stride
fusions.desc: When you gain health, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
